facts.fact: Subscribers: 67,057 at 2025-12 (Q4 2025), per POTRAZ, VSAT subscriptions (the category in which Starlink is classified), up from 50,949 in Q3 2025.
Starlink has been on sale in ZWE since its launch in September 2024, with 67,057 VSAT subscribers at Q4 2025 and a 17.23% share among alternative internet technologies.
